passages.text: Chief complaint: headache for three weeks with morning vomiting.
History: blurred vision for one week.
Neurologic exam: cranial nerves II through XII assessed. Fundoscopic exam shows bilateral papilledema. Strength, sensation, and gait normal.
Impression: headache with papilledema raises concern for an intracranial mass with raised intracranial pressure.
Plan: order MRI brain without and with contrast (CPT 70553).
